training_method: V4 continuation; official RLCD plus smoothed CE; partial-label masked public warmup; DDP
limitations: Local labels are synthetic and not independently human-confirmed production truth
Public labels are weak mappings and only known fields contribute loss
Published V4 test is regression evidence, not a fresh holdout
V4 calibration data are reused to fit temperatures
External diagnostic is weak-label QA, not production accuracy
No Jev API was used and no Jev accuracy is implied
